optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Mobile Application Engineer, Enterprise Knowledge Base
professionalSummary: Experienced mobile engineer with a proven track record in developing and maintaining offline sync and search features for enterprise knowledge base applications on iOS and Android. Demonstrated ability to reduce sync failure rates, improve crash‑free session metrics, and coordinate release activities with cross‑functional teams.

experienceHighlights: Developed a delta‑sync module in Kotlin and Swift that replaced full‑catalogue downloads with change‑set downloads and resumable transfers, directly addressing offline sync requirements.
Reduced sync failure rate from 6.8% to 2.1% between March and June releases, surpassing the published baseline of 6.8% for January‑February.
Coordinated release contents for four releases, managing sync and search changes while collaborating with the content team and release manager.
Triaged crash and sync reports from field staff, documenting root causes in the engineering wiki and linking each to the corresponding fix.
Managed offline sync development, quality‑indicator reporting, release coordination, and support triage for the knowledge base app over approximately two years.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Exported sync‑failure‑rate report from the app analytics dashboard (weekly rate, attempts, baseline line, release markers for March and June) and delta‑sync design note, providing verifiable evidence of performance improvements.
parsed.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work samples establish the candidate’s experience with offline sync development, quality‑indicator improvement, release coordination, and crash triage for the enterprise knowledge base app. They do not provide evidence of search feature development, specific documentation of known limitations, or detailed hand‑over procedures for releases.
